provenance.rule: A cited outlet label of the form 'WIRE via OUTLET' is a distributor's copy of the wire's story; owner of record = the wire. Any other label is its own owner. Wire services are those named in the task (AP, Reuters, AFP, Bloomberg).
provenance.label_convention: Wikipedia cite-news 'via=' parameter (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Template:Cite_news), as written in the saved Portal:Current events snapshots
provenance.evidence: labels in the saved snapshots 2026-11-17..19: 'AFP via France 24' x3, 'AFP via NDTV' x1, 'AFP via Philippine Daily Inquirer' x1, 'AFP via Le Monde' (second cited outlet), plus plain 'AFP' x5; no other 'via' labels
provenance.not_covered: an outlet that republishes a wire story without saying so (e.g. 'The Independent' next to 'AP') is its own owner here; MM3-0761 finding stays open for that case
